svg.title: Content pipeline: written once, drawn as images
svg.desc: Content pipeline in five steps. 1: every phrase is written once in a table with English, Sinhala and Tamil, its ID and answer type. 2: a Python tool renders Sinhala and Tamil with proper text shaping (Pillow with libraqm, Noto fonts). 3: each rendering becomes a run-length compressed 1-bit image. 4: images and an index load into each unit's EEPROM, content version 3. 5: the firmware draws English with its own font and Sinhala or Tamil from the images. The AT24C256 EEPROM, 32 KB, holds 29,219 of 32,768 bytes of phrase images (89.2%).
